{{Quote|This is Captain Raider. He recently escaped from Stars' End prison, and he has brought us important information. It seems that a slave ship carrying Wookiees is en route to a mysterious Imperial project. Wookiees are allies of the Alliance, and we must attempt to rescue them.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[H. S'man]]|<ref name="OSG" />}}
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] mounted a '''rescue mission''' to recover enslaved [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] being transported from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to work on the construction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] [[Toral (BFF-1 bulk freighter)|''Toral'']].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Hey, Raider. Come on. I haven't seen action in months. Let me go.''"<br />"''OK, Toalagar: You're in. You and Farlander over there.|Toalagar and Samuel Raider|<ref name="OSG" />}}
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="1BBY" /> Alliance forces [[Rescue from Stars' End|recovered]] a pair of Rebel pilots who had escaped from [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Mytus VII/Legends|Mytus VII]]. The pilots brought information that a ship carrying enslaved [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] was departing [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] bound for a secret Imperial military construction project. The Alliance planned a rescue mission, hoping to save the Wookiees and to learn more about what the Empire was building.<ref name="XW" /> One of the escaped pilots, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Samuel Raider]], was chosen to lead the mission, and selected his fellow escapee, [[Toalagar]], and Captain [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] to accompany him in a [[Flight group/Legends|group]] of three [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]].<ref name="OSG" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Red 3, why don't you go find another ship?|Samuel Raider, to Keyan Farlander|<ref name="OSG" />}}
Emerging from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the Rebels found the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] [[Toral (BFF-1 bulk freighter)|''Toral'']], escorted by six Imperial [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wings]], twelve [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], and the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Intrepid (Imperial I-class)|''Intrepid'']]. The Assault Gunboats moved to engage and Toalagar, flying as [[Red Two/Legends|Red Two]], was killed by a [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] on the first pass. Raider and Farlander eliminated the Star Wings and moved to engage the TIE fighters which had remained with the ''Toral''.<ref name="OSG" />

After Farlander [[Sensor/Legends|scanned]] the freighter to confirm its cargo, two [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] from [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] arrived to disable it with their [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], before the [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] [[Rescue 1 (Delta-class)|''Rescue 1'']] arrived to board it. Meanwhile, the ''Intrepid'' began launching reinforcements, which targeted the Rebel [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. The Rebel fighters held off the Imperials until ''Rescue 1'' completed the boarding operation and escaped into hyperspace with the Wookiees aboard.<ref name="OSG" />

==Aftermath==
Documents recovered from the ''Toral'' revealed that it was due to rendezvous with a larger convoy near [[Orron III]] before proceeding to the site of the construction project. In a subsequent [[Battle of Orron III|mission]], Rebel forces destroyed the convoy in the hopes of delaying construction while [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] uncovered more information about the nature of the project. The Rebels eventually learned that the construction project was the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], a [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] equipped with a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] capable of destroying a [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="XW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], in the second mission of "Tour of Duty II: The Great Search", "Rescue Wookiee Slaves."<ref name="XW" />
